blocks.text: Polished, Full HD video calls. The C920x Pro HD Webcam with microphone delivers remarkably crisp, clear, and detailed images in vibrant colors. Dual mics, placed on either side of the lens, capture the natural sound of your voice, making it great as a webcam for PC or a webcam for Mac.
